analysis: The code snippet calls executor.submit() with a non-null anonymous Runnable. The javadoc for submit() declares two exceptions: RejectedExecutionException and NullPointerException. NullPointerException is avoided because the Runnable argument is created inline and is not null. RejectedExecutionException is not avoided as there is no check to ensure the executor is not shut down or has capacity to accept new tasks.
answer: NullPointerException: throwing condition avoided (task is non-null). RejectedExecutionException: throwing condition not avoided (no validation before submit).
remark: RejectedExecutionException is thrown when the executor is unable to schedule the task, for example if the executor has been shut down or if its work queue is full. In the provided context, no such checks are performed before calling submit, so this exception can occur at runtime.
